module_summary: AXI3-to-AXI4 bridge: remaps AxCACHE/AxLOCK, registers AW/AR through skid buffers, de-interleaves write data by WID via a reorder block, and forwards B/R channels directly.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWADDR
anchors.why: AXI3 write address packed into the AW skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: AXI3 write data fed into WID reorder block.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WID
anchors.why: Write ID used by reorder block to de-interleave write beats.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: Reordered AXI4 write data output from reorder block.

anchors.name: wid_reorder_awready
anchors.why: Reorder block AW ready gating AW skid input and S_AXI_AWREADY.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: AW valid feeding skid buffer and reorder AW ID FIFO.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWREADY
anchors.why: AW ready requiring both skid buffer and reorder readiness.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WVALID
anchors.why: W valid into the reorder block.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WREADY
anchors.why: W ready from the reorder block.

anchors.name: axi4_awcache
anchors.why: AXI3-to-AXI4 remapped write cache attribute sent to AW skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARADDR
anchors.why: Read address packed into the AR skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Read data forwarded directly from master R channel.

anchors.name: axi4_arcache
anchors.why: Remapped read cache attribute sent to AR skid buffer.

anchors.name: axi4_awlock
anchors.why: AXI4 single-bit lock derived from AXI3 AWLOCK.

anchors.name: awskd_ready
anchors.why: AW skid buffer ready combined into S_AXI_AWREADY.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WVALID
anchors.why: Reordered W valid to AXI4 master.

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWADDR
anchors.why: Registered write address from AW skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: AR valid into AR skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARREADY
anchors.why: AR ready from AR skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: Write response valid forwarded from master.

groups.name: aw_channel_skid
groups.description: AW cache/lock remap and skid buffer registering write address.

groups.name: wid_reorder
groups.description: De-interleaves AXI3 write beats by WID into AXI4 write order.

groups.name: ar_channel_skid
groups.description: AR cache/lock remap and skid buffer registering read address.

groups.name: response_passthrough
groups.description: B and R channels forwarded combinationally from master to slave.
